# #1485 partial evidence and engineering handoff

This PR adds an issue-scoped output-admission reproduction packet under the reserved owned path. From fresh `origin/main` `088ab05aeb16ddfa8f0c43e596533f3f11d5fcec`, it produced two fresh retained-output vintages and two fresh corrected-report control vintages through the exact pinned shared immutable writer. Each writer admits the complete output set first, checks and accounts every consumed original and historical input, rejects unsafe output paths, publishes files exclusively and installs its completion receipt last. The 12-case adversarial run passed, and both runs of each writer were byte-identical. Full retained comparison preserves all 224 subjects and 27 province assessments, the 16 null-to-source Agar fields on four subjects, original classifications, the unresolved Sheopur source, and the 6,822/6,836 source-count difference.

This is a partial evidence PR. The new producer entry point republishes the two retained compressed report bytes; it does not execute the original geometry producer. The adapted control writer verifies and republishes the full retained comparison; it does not execute the unchanged historical `validate_controls.py` as the corrected writer. Thus it does not yet establish that the original producer and actual control CLI are repaired. The 40,040,002-byte declared decoded boundary source exceeds the 32 MiB input limit, so no new geometry science was run. Source licensing, current territorial correspondence, completeness, boundaries and neighboring granularity remain unverified. The packet preserves these limits and the original pins. Follow-up engineering must integrate the whole-set preflight and exclusive receipt-last publication into the original producer and actual control writer within an authorized engineering-owned path, then reproduce safe and adverse cases through those exact entry points.

The evidence validator reports `limited`, including four explicit factual/source limits; this records incomplete source review and is not a geographic correctness finding. No geographic approval, import, production write or publication is requested or inferred.

Refs #1485

Three candidates pass strict exact no-loss/additive checks and are included as proposal geometries. Four remain unresolved with exact residual or pre-existing-overlap geometries recorded. No core geometry changes are included. Historic cause, water/ice status, and boundary authority remain unresolved.

Evidence-quality validation confirms all 51 reviewed baseline pins and packet bytes; report status is limited by the declared authority and undated-context limits.

This is PR2 of the approved two-PR #1295 repair. It proposes atomic offline installation of the exact reviewed Quebec CAN103 and Newfoundland CAN114 additions together with release v8, native ownership, full context continuation, ownership/runtime/pixel/reference products, content revalidation and explicit certificate limits.

The complete scope remains four families/64 components, 24 current children, 477 retired members and all 12 neighbors. Only two geography records change; all 49,623 others and the 62 unresolved sibling components remain unchanged. The accepted original scientific pairs, complete source bytes, pointsets, interval/evidence tuples and execution vintages are retained. No source fitness, administrative/water/historical-cause approval or production action is added.

**Draft: the full normal package build and regression are pending the existing GitHub workflows.** The original deployment-budget workflow performs its complete checkout, Node24/Python3.12 setup, ordinary package tests and `npm run build:hosted`. The default package materializer and full hosted consumer restore exact delivered inputs before the actual original 17-module v6→v7 replay and strict v7→v8 verification. No new workflow, skipped test, local-only source, cached receipt substitution or deployment is requested. Ubuntu runtime observations will be recorded separately from the Mac observations.

The original replay child alone uses literal `--max-old-space-size=768`; outer Node remains plain. Four actual boundary/brand/fold controls and the separate plain-parent/child-argv control passed independently. This flag is not an RSS bound or a claim that the full build fits. All earlier failed admissions and build attempts remain preserved with their genuine source/runtime/log/timing vintages.

Preliminary actual evidence validation passed with explicit factual-source limits: 181 whole descriptors, 267,586,939 encoded bytes, six archived native-result/output bindings and all 32 original baseline bodies. The prior full source-image proof authenticates every one of 7,242 package inputs at its true 8a5 execution vintage; corrected helper/transport bodies have distinct exact immutable bindings. The final packet and acceptance will be refreshed to the actual PR head, CI logs/artifacts and complete remaining obligations before independent approval or normal merge queue.

The first hosted run at5dc616 failed before original-v1 replay because Ubuntu Node re-encoded the retained context gzip differently; all three regression shards reached the same strict guard. Corrected head91889afa reconstructs that exact encoded member and both exact outer transport parts using the existing copy/literal byte codec. Complete encoded/decoded inverses and six real rejection controls passed; no compression encoder, source geometry change or scientific calculation participates. The original failure remains preserved. The next existing full hosted checks and final independent acceptance remain pending.

The second hosted package attempt passed compressed restoration, then stopped on a stale current-wrapper pin for the newly merged evidence library. Head896bdf15 includes public main6d15b and its exact whole23246-byte library binding; all31 current imports are checked. The original17 historical modules retain their accepted old bytes. The API base and actual current merge input are now6d15b; no shared library or scientific algorithm was edited by this repair. Both failures remain preserved, and the third existing hosted execution is pending.

Evidence manifest: `coordination/engineering/eastern-two-gap-repair-native-20261007/evidence-quality.json`.
